method: Pre-remediation snapshot of 56 files enumerated before audit outputs existed. Complete contents were read programmatically, with per-file language/role/source-reference inspection and targeted reading of provenance and access caveats. All 101 master-register rows were inspected against existing evidence notes. No new web retrieval or independent original-text comparison was performed. Existing inspected-source claims are historical evidence, not a fresh accessibility guarantee.

taxonomy.not verifiable: Original provenance/content cannot be established or accessed from existing evidence; not merely absence of a local original. A readable mirror can still have an explicit unresolved original-access gap.
taxonomy.translated: Source-derived English paraphrase/summary, usually of Chinese text; not necessarily literal translation. For already-English sources this forced category means same-language summary, explicitly identified in the row.
taxonomy.raw: Exact locally saved original-language text. For internally authored plans/templates/indexes this refers only to the internal authored original, never an external source archive.
